verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS company-formation and compliance platform, not an AI agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The pricing line 'Advanced API integrations' is an unrelated feature. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. 'Registered agent' refers to the legal service, not AI agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
